analyzed_vuln.description: Heap buffer overflow is caused by Script::subset() writing serialized LangSys offsets into out->langSys.arrayZ[i] based on source count (langSys.len) without ensuring the destination embedded Script has enough room for that many records after subsetting. The loop uses source count and performs offset.serialize_subset() writes into potentially smaller/truncated output object, leading to a 1-byte OOB write when BEInt::set stores the offset.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Triggered via hb-subset-fuzzer on a malformed GSUB table where Script/RecordList structures and offsets survive sanitize enough to enter GSUBGPOS subsetting, but produce inconsistent size/state during serialization. In _subset2(), a fixed estimated buffer is allocated and Script::subset embeds/copies Script then iterates langSys.len from input; with crafted font data this causes writes past the allocated serialized table region (out-of-bounds write in BEInt::set via out->langSys.arrayZ[i].offset).
